_comment: Single config for the 'Siang Terik Sawah' camera preset (webcam UVC /dev/video0). Every range and threshold lives here. Edits apply on the next API request - no restart needed.

exposure._comment: The webcam has no EV control. EV is emulated as manual exposure: exposure_time_absolute = reference_units * 2^EV (1 unit = 100 us). With reference 312 (31.2 ms, the driver default) EV -2..0 maps to 78..312 = the driver minimum (7.8 ms) .. default.

white_balance._comment: Replaces ColourGains R/B (not supported by this webcam): fixed white balance in Kelvin, AWB off. ~5500 K = midday sun.

focus._comment: Replaces LensPosition in dioptres: the webcam exposes focus_absolute in unitless steps 0..15 (continuous AF off while set).

preview._comment: Live MJPEG preview rate. The webcam delivers 30 fps; 20 keeps CPU/power low and fits slower links (Tailscale relay). Lower it for slow networks.

analysis._comment: Indicators are computed on the live preview frame downscaled to width_px, at most once per interval_s.

leaf_mask._comment: OpenCV HSV (H 0-179, S/V 0-255). A pixel is 'leaf' if it falls in ANY enabled range. Enable kuning/coklat for diseased leaves. A blown-out leaf pixel turns white (no saturation) and falls outside every colour range, so each blob of clipped pixels is judged by its surroundings: if at least clip_enclosed_ratio of a clip_ring_px ring around it is leaf, the whole blob counts as clipped leaf.

quality._comment: clip_level: a pixel counts as clipped if any channel >= this. sharpness_min is a starting guess (Laplacian variance at analysis.width_px) - calibrate it in the field.
